title: [Master] [Repair Item] Team Member unable to copy sales quotation when lines are associated to assembly
summary: Fixed an issue where a Team Member user could not copy a sales quotation when its lines were associated with assembly. Copy Document Mgt. was adjusted in W1 and several localization layers, with a new test added.
key_points: Team Member users can now copy sales quotations whose lines are linked to assembly
Copy Document Mgt. updated in W1 and the ES, IT, NA, NL and RU layers
New test coverage added in the SCM copy document tests
